quests.title: Name Cartographer
quests.task: Capture forward and reverse resolution separately, with chain, block, resolver, timestamp and match/mismatch. Start with jaywisdom.eth as an unverified input label; do not substitute a Base name silently.

quests.title: Control Detective
quests.task: Review a scoped signature proof: exact challenge, repository, name, chain, nonce, expiration and recovered signer. Distinguish resolved address, controller and signer. No signing action is requested by this board.

quests.title: Repository Librarian
quests.task: Bind a receipt to jsonwisdom/COMPUTERWISDOM, an immutable commit and artifact path. A wallet signature does not prove GitHub account control; capture that proof separately if claimed.

quests.title: Check Run Sleuth
quests.task: Capture workflow run and job IDs, exact head SHA, event, result and coverage. Repeated job names are not identities. Use PR #590 as a read-only case study; successful CI does not imply merge or trade.

quests.title: Double-O-HOLD
quests.task: Preserve a mismatch or missing receipt and explain the resulting HOLD. Correctly finding an open edge earns game feedback without creating a factual PASS.

quests.title: Replay Guide
quests.task: Explain to another player why ENS, signature, repository binding, CI and merge are different claims. Record reflection: what did you believe, and what survived?
